title: Bruce and the Spider
author: James Baldwin
summary: 苏格兰国王布鲁斯六次战败后，从一只反复结网的蜘蛛身上学到坚持。
publicDomainBasis: Published 1896 by the American Book Company; author James Baldwin (1841–1925). Public domain in the United States and in China (author's life plus 70 years).

paragraphs.en: There was once a king of Scotland whose name was Robert Bruce. He had need to be both brave and wise, for the times in which he lived were wild and rude. The King of England was at war with him, and had led a great army into Scotland to drive him out of the land.
paragraphs.zh: 从前有一位苏格兰国王，名叫罗伯特·布鲁斯。他所处的时代野蛮而动荡，因此他必须既勇敢又睿智。英格兰国王正与他交战，率领大军侵入苏格兰，想把他赶出这片土地。

paragraphs.en: Battle after battle had been fought. Six times had Bruce led his brave little army against his foes; and six times had his men been beaten, and driven into flight. At last his army was scattered, and he was forced to hide himself in the woods and in lonely places among the mountains.
paragraphs.zh: 一场接一场的仗打下来。布鲁斯六次率领他那支勇敢的小军队迎战敌人，六次都被打败，被迫四处逃散。最后，他的军队溃散了，他只好躲进森林和山间的僻静之处。

paragraphs.en: One rainy day, Bruce lay on the ground under a rude shed, listening to the patter of the drops on the roof above him. He was tired and sick at heart, and ready to give up all hope. It seemed to him that there was no use for him to try to do anything more.
paragraphs.zh: 一个下雨天，布鲁斯躺在一个简陋棚子下的地上，听着雨点敲打头顶棚顶的声音。他身心俱疲，心灰意冷，几乎要放弃全部希望。他觉得，自己再做什么努力都没有用了。

paragraphs.en: As he lay thinking, he saw a spider over his head, making ready to weave her web. He watched her as she toiled slowly and with great care. Six times she tried to throw her frail thread from one beam to another, and six times it fell short.
paragraphs.zh: 他躺着思索时，看见头顶有一只蜘蛛正在准备织网。他注视着它缓慢而小心翼翼地劳作。它六次试图把细弱的丝从一根横梁抛到另一根横梁上，六次都差了一点。

paragraphs.en: "Poor thing!" said Bruce: "you, too, know what it is to fail."
paragraphs.zh: “可怜的小东西！”布鲁斯说，“你也尝过失败的滋味。”

paragraphs.en: But the spider did not lose hope with the sixth failure. With still more care, she made ready to try for the seventh time. Bruce almost forgot his own troubles as he watched her swing herself out upon the slender line. Would she fail again? No! The thread was carried safely to the beam, and fastened there.
paragraphs.zh: 可是蜘蛛并没有因为第六次失败就放弃希望。它更加小心地准备做第七次尝试。布鲁斯看着它顺着那根细丝荡出去，几乎忘记了自己的烦恼。它还会失败吗？没有！丝线稳稳地搭到了横梁上，并在那里固定住了。

paragraphs.en: "I, too, will try a seventh time!" cried Bruce.
paragraphs.zh: “我也要再试第七次！”布鲁斯喊道。

paragraphs.en: He arose and called his men together. He told them of his plans, and sent them out with messages of cheer to his disheartened people. Soon there was an army of brave Scotchmen around him. Another battle was fought, and the King of England was glad to go back into his own country.
paragraphs.zh: 他站起身来，把部下召集到一起。他向他们讲述自己的计划，并派他们出去，给灰心丧气的同胞送去鼓舞人心的消息。不久，他身边又聚集起一支勇敢的苏格兰军队。又一场战斗打响了，英格兰国王最终灰溜溜地退回了自己的国家。

paragraphs.en: I have heard it said, that, after that day, no one by the name of Bruce would ever hurt a spider. The lesson which the little creature had taught the king was never forgotten.
paragraphs.zh: 我听说，从那以后，姓布鲁斯的人再也不会伤害蜘蛛。那只小生灵教给国王的道理，他终身未忘。
